title: Survival Simplicity
description: A simple vanilla addon that makes the game feel more fresh
body: Survival Simplicity is a simple addon to vanilla Minecraft that makes the game feel fresh. This adds many new animals such as the monkey (which is tameable!!!) or the seahorse, structures, biomes like a redwood forest, new food such as bananas, and even a new dimension called the deep blue to the game as well as helpful mods such as the waystone mod and xaeros minimap. This is a really fun mod that is perfect for anyone looking for for simple new changes to vanilla Minecraft.
